summary: Integrate and measure the premium tree family in the live dense forest
areas: Dense forest render resources, wind, grounding, and impostors

physics.reason: The 120 Hz solver, terrain contact, input trace, collision records, and skier state are unchanged; the tree family remains presentation-only.

world.reason: Existing forest placement records, density, terrain, and physical tree/collision authority are retained; only the renderer-owned mesh, texture, and impostor resources are replaced.

data.reason: No replay, race, save, record, ghost, or compatibility schema was changed.

mountains.reason: The v15 physical mountain and 4 m terrain data are unchanged.

races.reason: Race definitions and route identity are unchanged.

records.reason: Record eligibility and storage are unchanged.

ghosts.reason: Replay input and ghost playback schemas are unchanged.

caches.reason: Physical and scenery cache identities remain unchanged; generated render resources use the established import contract.

checks.details: 384 density/LOD checks, 3,845 forest-preparation checks, 200 colourful-forest checks, and 20 tree-dynamics checks passed. Grounding also passed 474 checks with no failures.

38 inspected Standard-mountain frames prove the premium family rendering at near, mid, far, and sampled transition distances with real FC_Tree, FC_Broadleaf, and FC_Impostor materials; physical identity remained 24b0e801dcbb7cbc299b7364db03daf234be77ac5053d21ad27b8d7cbaca9875.

checks.command: ./scripts/compare_forest.ps1 -Snapshot artifacts/premium_tree_forest_pair_20260915_final_r1 -Mode Measure -Label premium_tree_ab_20260915_r1; then the same frozen snapshot candidate-first and baseline-second with premium_tree_ab_20260915_orderrev_* labels
checks.details: Two opposing-order, three-repetition 15-second exact-trace sets at 3840x2160 High, FSR Auto 4.1.1 at 0.75 internal scale, effects retained and frame generation disabled completed with 0 unfocused frames, cache hits, no failures, and native GPU timestamp capture. The candidate is a measured regression, not a claimed improvement.
Rendered inspection confirms the live visual candidate but does not establish player/controller perception over a full descent.

outstanding_acceptance: The premium family is a live, visually inspected and measured candidate, but it is not recommended for performance adoption: the matched dense-forest benchmark regressed.
No human/controller full-descent visual acceptance is claimed.
